ground_velocity_world.description: ground velocity at the contact point

action.limitation: policy action; execution/action-manager semantics are not recorded

foot_contact_force_xyz_n.limitation: per-foot aggregate force, not raw per-contact records

foot_contact_force_norm_n.limitation: force magnitude; does not separate normal/tangent

foot_point_actual.limitation: fixed tracked foot sites, not physical contact points

foot_point_velocity_actual.limitation: fixed tracked site velocity, not selected contact-point velocity

joint_pos_actual.limitation: joint position only; no paired joint velocity/torque

irrecoverable_from_recorded_arrays.raw_contact_point: fixed tracked foot sites are not solver contact points
irrecoverable_from_recorded_arrays.raw_contact_normal: no solver contact normal is recorded
irrecoverable_from_recorded_arrays.raw_tangential_contact_force: only aggregate XYZ or normal force is recorded
irrecoverable_from_recorded_arrays.contact_point_velocity: foot_point_velocity_actual is a fixed site velocity and the required rigid-body angular velocity/contact lever arm pair is absent
irrecoverable_from_recorded_arrays.moving_ground_velocity: ground velocity and ground-body identity are absent
irrecoverable_from_recorded_arrays.randomization_metadata: seed, friction, mass and disturbances are not complete per trajectory

verdict: No historical file contains the complete direct V1 input/label contract. Diagnostic proxies must not be promoted to physical ground truth.
